units.source_text: [\[6\]](#part1335.html#w6) 古代宫中制度：陪膳的侍女，

en.t: Under the ancient palace system, the maidservants who attended at meals

units.source_text: 必须将额发掠起，上面插个梳子，方是正式打扮。

en.t: had to sweep up the hair over their foreheads and place a comb above it; only then was it considered proper formal attire.

units.source_text: 在挂下的额发上插梳子，是不伦不类的。

en.t: To stick a comb into forehead hair that was hanging down was considered awkward and improper.
